ordered_prerequisite.reason: Bind the accepted PA-before-MI sequence without modifying the author's exact-hash MI candidate.

authorized_actions: Create one non-recursive immutable snapshot containing exactly the five candidate-bound artifacts, the candidate and its verification receipt.
Create a sorted fixed-timestamp ZIP and SHA-256 manifest.
Restore into a newly created empty temporary directory and verify exact path set, bytes and SHA-256.
Parse JSON and the prepared expected-red Python source by AST only.
Statically verify MI-01 through MI-10 coverage without importing or executing the test module.
Create an acceptance record only if every authorized static check passes.
Create a local Git commit without a remote.
not_authorized: Executing pytest or any expected-red test.
Changing production, analysis or existing test implementation.
Installing or downloading packages or source.
Calling an objective, constraint, benchmark, optimizer or evaluator.
Reading or analyzing formal result packages.
Executing S6-E0, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or formal FFE.
Freezing NS, NV, BM or SA by inference.
Forming performance, novelty, robustness or paper-readiness conclusions.
Remote push, public release or submission.
